name: cond_matrix
title: Conditional-operator matrix: every when-condition operator at flatten time
description: A 6-lane generator selects each lane's source (P or Q) by a distinct compile-time relational/boolean operator over the loop index (==, !=, <, >=, <=, >, &&, ||). Operators never become gates; the lane vector is [P,Q,P,P,Q,Q] (LSB-first). P-only -> 13, Q-only -> 50, both -> 63.
